axis: evaluation oracle re-anchor: submission-contract validation and invalid-action LB proxy
hypothesis: Penalizing execution-invalid actions and modeling time, market, and worker constraints will expose candidates whose offline asset gain cannot transfer to leaderboard execution.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2286/SOT-2287-oracle.json; deterministic screen 5060.33 vs 4356.67 and independent confirm 4968.80 vs 4352.00, both with 0 invalid actions/contract violations; exec compatibility PASS; no Kaggle submission

axis: global spatiotemporal worker assignment with deadline, travel, and movement-conflict cost
hypothesis: Jointly assigning urgent tasks across all workers will reduce duplicate movement and prevent low-value planting from delaying harvest/water work, improving the re-anchored leaderboard proxy.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2286/SOT-2289-spatiotemporal-assignment.json; screen final_assets 5733.67 vs 5060.33 and conflicts 7.00 vs 25.00; independent confirm 5712.60 vs 4968.80 and conflicts 8.20 vs 32.20; 0 invalid actions/contract violations; exec compatibility PASS; no Kaggle submission

axis: finite-horizon crop, sale, seed reserve, and hire opportunity-cost planning
hypothesis: Valuing only harvests realizable before the deadline, selling at the best known remaining price, and gating seed/hire spend by remaining returns will improve final assets over daily-margin decisions.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2286/SOT-2288-horizon-economy.json; screen final_assets 6114.67 vs 5733.67 and independent confirm 6057.60 vs 5712.60; 0 invalid actions/contract violations; exec compatibility PASS; no Kaggle submission

axis: runtime-compatible observation, crop lifecycle, inventory flow, and cash-only reward oracle
hypothesis: Re-anchoring the proxy to the published 10x10/30x24 runtime contract and bank-only terminal reward will remove optimistic valuation and hidden-hint drift before further strategy tuning.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2338/SOT-2339-runtime-oracle.json and SOT-2339-runtime-contract.md; screen reward 4314.67 and independent confirm reward 4353.20; 0 invalid actions/contract violations; exec compatibility PASS; no Kaggle submission

axis: domain-randomized market, crop, board, weed, horizon, and worker promotion gate
hypothesis: Independent distribution-shift screen/confirm suites with lower-tail and worst-case checks will prevent fixed-scenario overfitting while preserving runtime validity.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2338/SOT-2340-distribution-shift-gate.json; screen lower-quantile/worst reward 4123/4123 and confirm 4265/4232; 0 invalid actions/contract violations; exec compatibility PASS; no Kaggle submission

axis: observed cultivable-capacity labor scaling with collision-first assignment
hypothesis: Replacing the fixed hand target with a bounded target derived from observed cultivable land and remaining harvest opportunity, while making collision avoidance dominate deadline ties, will improve wide-board lower-tail reward without degrading shifted small-board performance or runtime validity.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2338/SOT-2341-adaptive-worker-capacity.json and SOT-2341-policy-rationale.md; screen lower-quantile reward 4123 vs 4123; independent confirm lower-quantile reward 4368 vs 4265 and mean reward 4438.83 vs 4401.67; mean assignment conflicts 0.17 vs 0.33; 0 invalid actions/contract violations; exec compatibility PASS; no Kaggle submission

axis: public-observation deterministic bounded rollout for limited-horizon action-sequence comparison
hypothesis: A dependency-free forward model that freezes unobserved future dynamics and scores cash, seeds, workers, collisions, and deadline will let later limited-horizon/MCTS planners compare candidate sequences without oracle leakage.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2380/SOT-2384-bounded-rollout.json; same-screen terminal rollout score 35 vs 20; full policy screen/independent-confirm gates PASS; 0 invalid actions/contract violations; exec compatibility PASS; approach informed by finite-horizon simulation and model-error cautions in AAAI DOI 10.1609/aaai.v38i18.29994; no Kaggle submission

axis: strictly bounded deterministic receding-horizon beam planner over joint economy and worker actions
hypothesis: A depth-3, width-6 public-state beam with capped branching/cache will improve reward tails by valuing harvest, planting, movement, collisions, cash reserve, seed purchases, hires, and sales jointly.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2380/SOT-2385-bounded-beam-planner.json; screen mean reward 4329.25 vs champion 4366.75 and lower-tail 4107 vs 4123; 0 invalid actions/contract violations and 0 assignment conflicts, but reward/profit promotion thresholds failed; confirm correctly skipped; candidate code and tests reverted; champion retained; no Kaggle submission

axis: public-observation market/board/horizon/resource regime selector over deterministic policy portfolio
hypothesis: Weight-free switching among best-return/price-aware, immediate-liquidation, and wheat-stability policies using board openness, remaining horizon, observed market volatility, and cash/seed pressure will improve lower-tail or worst-case reward without contract/runtime regressions.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2380/SOT-2386-regime-policy-portfolio.json and SOT-2386-policy-rationale.md; screen mean/lower-tail/worst reward exactly tied champion at 4366.75/4123/4123, with 0 invalid actions and 0 contract violations; strict tail-improvement gate rejected the axis and confirm was correctly skipped; candidate policy code reverted; champion retained; submission contract PASS; no Kaggle submission

axis: leaderboard-aligned multi-farm shared-market competitive evaluation oracle
hypothesis: Replaying public multi-farm observations, player-shared worker seed resources, lockstep shared-market order effects, and relative cash rank will remove the single-farm cash-proxy drift before opponent-aware policy work.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2413/SOT-2414-competitive-oracle.json and SOT-2414-oracle-provenance.md; fixed screen seed 2414 PASS (scores 3063/3025, ranks 1/2, relative +38), independent confirm seed 9413 PASS (3053/3049, ranks 1/2, relative +4); unchanged candidate policy separately REJECTED by legacy distribution screen and confirm skipped; submission contract PASS; no Kaggle submission

axis: bounded public-observation online identification with three-scenario lower-tail receding-horizon crop planning
hypothesis: Updating a bounded price/yield/weed uncertainty set from observed runtime history and choosing crops by a two-worst-scenario CVaR proxy will improve shifted reward tails without the rejected fixed depth-3 width-6 beam or fixed regime selector.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2413/SOT-2416-robust-online-planner.json; fixed screen mean/lower-tail/worst reward 5144.25/4646/4646 vs 4366.75/4123/4123; independent confirm 6920.5/6838/6702 vs 4442/4368/4258; 0 invalid actions, contract violations, and assignment conflicts; exec compatibility PASS; no Kaggle submission

axis: opponent-aware public-farm and shared-inventory scarcity policy for seed, hire, and sale timing
hypothesis: Aggregating only public opponent cash/workers/field demand and shared inventory will avoid crowded overbuying while advancing seed/labor capacity and selling into scarcity pressure.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2413/SOT-2415-opponent-aware-scarcity.json; competitive fixed screen candidate 3/3 checks vs champion 2/3 and independent confirm 1/1; distribution screen mean reward 5144.25 vs 4366.75 and confirm 6920.5 vs 4442; 0 invalid actions, contract violations, and assignment conflicts; opponent permutation/private-mutation unit test PASS; exec compatibility PASS; no Kaggle submission

axis: entity-isolated opponent/seat/seed temporal holdout with paired champion-candidate A/B
hypothesis: Separating opponent and seed entities across chronologically ordered screen/confirm windows, then swapping both seats on identical seeds, will provide a leak-free promotion oracle with direct rank and tail evidence.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2756/SOT-2758-leak-free-cv.json; isolation checks PASS (opponent/seed/episode disjoint, confirm strictly later, private/future-price fields rejected); paired screen mean/lower-tail/worst reward delta +1808.5/+1758/+1758 and confirm +1866/+1820/+1820, candidate rank 1.0 across 4 episodes per window; terminal bank reward, shared-market oracle, screen→confirm, deterministic tests, submission contract and exec compatibility PASS; no Kaggle submission

axis: public-clock terminal inventory recovery and deadline liquidation versus PRICE_AWARE
hypothesis: Using the public remaining-turn horizon to force terminal shed liquidation and suppress non-realizable seed/hire spend will reduce stranded inventory and improve terminal bank reward without worsening paired rank or tails.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2756/SOT-2759-terminal-recovery.json; leak-free same-seed/both-seat screen and independent temporal confirm each produced mean/lower-tail/worst reward delta 0 with candidate rank 1.0 (ties); distribution screen mean reward 5290 vs 5290, lower-tail/worst unchanged, terminal unliquidated value 252 vs 252, order drops 0, invalid actions/contract violations 0; strict tail-improvement gate failed, confirm skipped by the distribution gate, candidate implementation reverted; no Kaggle submission

axis: finite-horizon land unlock and livestock allocation driven by public town demand
hypothesis: Investing in land and animals only when remaining public-horizon town revenue covers land, animal, feed, and crop opportunity costs will improve paired rank and lower-tail reward over the crop-only champion.
evidence: docs/measurements/SOT-2756/SOT-2760-mixed-farm.json; same-seed/both-seat leak-free CV screen mean/lower-tail/worst reward delta +289/+262/+262 and confirm +347/+310/+310 with candidate rank 1.0; distribution screen mean reward 5564.5 vs 5290 and mixed-farm actions 3.5 with 0 invalid actions/contract violations, but independent distribution confirm lower-tail final-assets ratio 0.943 and worst ratio 0.955 failed the non-regression gate; candidate implementation reverted; no Kaggle submission
